22:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: The Detour With David Chang
After being called out for writing off Pittsburgh's food scene, David Chang meets up with a native, actress Gillian Jacobs, to see what else he's got wrong. They then head to Philly to visit his favorite food spots, in a tale of two cities.

23:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Real Time With Bill Maher
An interview with Michael Douglas, award-winning actor, producer, and author of the new memoir "One Helluva Ride"; panel discussion includes Sen. Thom Tillis, Republican senator from North Carolina and author of "How to Lose Friends and Antagonize Presidents: The Trouble with Sycophants, Courage Outsourcing, and Partisan Groupthink" and Sara Eisen, co-anchor of CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" and "Money Movers".
